WITH ranked_entertainer_styles AS (
    SELECT 
        e.EntertainerID,
        e.EntStageName,
        es.StyleID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.EntertainerID ORDER BY es.StyleStrength, es.StyleID) as rn
    FROM Entertainers e
    JOIN Entertainer_Styles es ON e.EntertainerID = es.EntertainerID
    WHERE es.StyleStrength <= 3
),
entertainer_first_style AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, EntStageName, StyleID as FirstStyle
    FROM ranked_entertainer_styles
    WHERE rn = 1
),
entertainer_second_style AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, EntStageName, StyleID as SecondStyle
    FROM ranked_entertainer_styles
    WHERE rn = 2
),
customer_first_pref AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID as FirstPref
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    WHERE PreferenceSeq = 1
),
customer_second_pref AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID as SecondPref
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    WHERE PreferenceSeq = 2
),
customer_with_two_prefs AS (
    SELECT cfp.CustomerID, cfp.FirstPref, cps.SecondPref
    FROM customer_first_pref cfp
    JOIN customer_second_pref cps ON cfp.CustomerID = cps.CustomerID
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    ef.EntStageName,
    cust.CustLastName
FROM entertainer_first_style ef
JOIN entertainer_second_style es ON ef.EntertainerID = es.EntertainerID
JOIN customer_with_two_prefs cwp ON 1=1
JOIN Customers cust ON cwp.CustomerID = cust.CustomerID
WHERE 
    (ef.FirstStyle = cwp.FirstPref AND es.SecondStyle = cwp.SecondPref)
    OR
    (ef.FirstStyle = cwp.SecondPref AND es.SecondStyle = cwp.FirstPref)
